subject: Audit visibility & retention: queryability exceptions and roadmap asks
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-05-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit visibility request from ClearWave — needs triage

Team —

ClearWave (contact: Lydia Park) just surfaced a compliance gap in their SOC2 fieldwork. They are asking for a "queryable archive" of audit events that goes beyond our standard 30-day hot retention window for a subset of event types (auth, config-change, data-access). Specifically: 90 days of indexable events for ad-hoc forensic queries and a documented export process for auditor evidence.

They also want clarity on:
- What we can provide today (scheduled exports, raw logs) vs. what would require product work (indexing / query layer).
- Expected cost / egress / storage impact for 90-day searchable window.
- Controls: RBAC, signed manifests, tamper-evidence for exported bundles.

Attachments: audit_log_schema_v2.xlsx (sample event set), retention_cost_estimate_q2.pdf (rough numbers).

Asks: can Security/Infra confirm a short-term workaround for the auditor next week? Product: can you assess roadmap fit + rough implementation timeline for an indexable cold-log store (phased)? Ops: what's the gating dependency for exports/escrow?

I propose a triage call tomorrow to align owners and deliverable for the auditor.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
chloe@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit visibility request from ClearWave — needs triage

Chloe —

Thanks for the flag. Quick notes after looking at the schema you attached and chatting with infra:

1) Immediate workaround (<=7 days): we can produce a time-bounded export pipeline that pulls raw event blobs for the requested event types and writes them to a customer-specific S3 bucket (or escrow) with a signed manifest and SHA256 checksums. That covers auditor evidence but is NOT indexable for ad-hoc queries — searches would be offline and require our team to run lookups.

2) Mid-term (6–8 weeks): a search-capable pilot using existing cold storage + ephemeral indexing: ingest older events into a read-only index (per-tenant) optimized for the requested fields. This requires ~2 engineers (infra + search infra) and has an estimated incremental storage cost. It also requires policy-level changes to allow longer retention of derived indices.

3) Controls: we can add RBAC to exports and ensure manifests are signed using KMS. For BYOK/KMS customers we need to confirm key-use policies (Ben, can you confirm whether BYOK customers allow us to produce signatures? If not, we need escrow with customer-signed attestations).

Short-term ask: Ben — can you run a quick check on KMS signing constraints and whether an escrowed S3 export is acceptable from a compliance perspective? Marissa — if product agrees, I can scope the pilot and provide a stop-gap runbook for the auditor.

On quoting the request:
> "queryable archive of audit events ... 90 days"

This is a reasonable ask but not trivial at scale. Let's discuss tradeoffs on the triage call.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-07T13:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit visibility request from ClearWave — needs triage

Chloe / Jonas —

Thanks. Product is aligned on a phased approach; high level: 

Phase A (next 7 days): Evidence bundle + runbook. Deliverable: export of raw events + signed manifest, auditor-friendly CSV and manifest template. Low effort; we can ship via ops.

Phase B (MVP, 6–8 weeks): Ad-hoc queryability for specific event types. Scope: build an offline indexing job that turns cold logs into a read-optimized index (limited fields), provide a query API for support/compliance to run ad-hoc queries (read-only, RBAC). Cost: moderate. We need infra estimate for storage and index compute.

Phase C (Q3 roadmap): Full platform capability — configurable retention windows, tenant-level searchable cold store, UI for compliance exports, usage quotas. This is a larger product change and should be budgeted for the roadmap planning cycle.

Tradeoffs to call out:
- Indexable storage increases per-tenant storage + retrieval costs.
- We should avoid incentivizing indefinite searchable retention; consider quotas and paid upgrade (Dedicated/Private).

Action items:
- Jonas: produce runbook (Phase A) and security controls checklist.
- Ben: confirm BYOK signing constraints & any legal blockers.
- Infra (we'll ask infra to estimate cost for Phase B; Chloe, can you prioritize the ClearWave deal in HubSpot so we can attach cost estimates to the opportunity?)

I can slot Phase B for the 6–8 week sprint if leadership approves prioritization.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Lydia Park <lydia@clearwave.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>
Cc: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2-audit@trustaudit.io>
Date: 2028-05-08T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit visibility request from ClearWave — needs triage

Chloe —

Thanks for the quick response and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side that will help the triage: 

- The auditor expects indexable access for at least auth and data-access events for 90 days; if a fully interactive search UI is not available, a process where Redwood runs queries on our behalf within SLA is acceptable.
- Data residency: the archive must remain within us-east-1. Please confirm the export/escrow option can be constrained regionally.
- Evidence format: auditor prefers NDJSON with a signed manifest. The attached evidence_bundle_instructions.docx outlines the minimum fields.
- Timeline: the auditor will accept a runbook + one complete evidence bundle by 2028-05-15 to proceed with the engagement.

We appreciate a quick triage call and an owner-level point of contact.

—Lydia Park
Director, Information Security (ClearWave Health)
lydia@clearwave.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia@clearwave.com>, SOC2 Audit Team <soc2-audit@trustaudit.io>
Date: 2028-05-09T15:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit visibility request from ClearWave — needs triage — decisions & next steps

Team / Lydia —

Recap & owners after today's quick triage: 

Decisions:
- Phase A (runbook + evidence bundle) is the immediate priority. Deliverable due: 2028-05-15 (per ClearWave ask).
- Phase B (indexable pilot) approved for scoping; tentative 6–8 week delivery if infra budget approved.
- Regional constraint (us-east-1) is required by ClearWave; operations will ensure exports are region-scoped.

Owners & next steps:
- Jonas: produce the Evidence Runbook and signed-manifest template (owner). Due: 2028-05-11. Attestation on RBAC controls included.
- Ben: confirm BYOK/KMS signing constraints and whether customer key policies block manifest signing. Due: 2028-05-10.
- Marissa: produce Phase B product spec and priority ask for roadmap sloting, include cost anchors. Due: 2028-05-12.
- Chloe: coordinate with ClearWave and attach Phase A estimate to HubSpot deal_004982. Deliverable: evidence bundle acceptance test.

Attachments for this thread: audit_log_schema_v2.xlsx, retention_cost_estimate_q2.pdf, evidence_bundle_instructions.docx

I'll open a shared drive folder and a short-run Jira epic for Phase A so audit can track the evidence production. Thanks everyone — let's keep comms tight until May 15.

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
chloe@redwood.ai
